description: Print the whole memory (or the subtree at path) as one Markdown document, for a person who wants to read it. Each place starts with a line <!-- node: PATH -->; strings are printed as they are, other JSON values become ```json blocks. Long output is cut at max_bytes; then export a child path. To look things up yourself use memory instead. Errors: NodeMissing, PathBad, MemoryMissing.

path.description: a path like errors.json or cli/ or errors.json#/codes; empty or / is the root (default)
